map_note: 218,880 of the 23,444,011 mail-ballot requests in the Election Lab's data have no district, so request figures on the map add up to 23,225,131. 38,789 of the 3,421,226 ballots cast in the Election Lab's data (1.1%) have no state Assembly district and appear only in the statewide total.
